correctness.rationale: The local test uses the zero-padding convention at both open ends and checks precisely the vertices labeled zero. I independently recovered the displayed potential by shortest-path relaxation on pair states using column weight minus one. Checking all finite inequalities proves the lower bound at every length by telescoping, and alternating 01 and 10 attains it. A path attains equality exactly when all slacks are zero. Independent trimming left 12 states, 16 arrows, and connector states 12 and 28 as both initial and final. First-return excursions alternate connectors, with one of each length 1, 2 and 5 from either connector; this is bijective including the empty composition for n=2. The recurrence and displayed counts follow. For the growth rate the positive root of x+x²+x⁵=1 is simple; equality in the triangle inequality on its circle forces x positive since exponents 1 and 2 are present. Its reciprocal is 1.704902776041646… .
